title: X-VC: Zero-shot Streaming Voice Conversion in Codec Space
abstract: arXiv:2604.12456v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Zero-shot voice conversion (VC) aims to convert a source utterance into the voice of an unseen target speaker while preserving its linguistic content. Although recent systems have improved conversion quality, building zero-shot VC systems for interactive scenarios remains challenging because high-fidelity speaker transfer and low-latency streaming inference are difficult to achieve simultaneously. In this work, we present X-VC, a zero-shot streaming VC system that performs one-step conversion in the latent space of a pretrained neural codec. X-VC uses a dual-conditioning acoustic converter that jointly models source codec latents and frame-level acoustic conditions derived from target reference speech, while injecting utterance-level target speaker information through adaptive normalization. translated_title: X-VC：编解码器空间中的零样本流式语音转换
translated_abstract: 零样本语音转换（VC）旨在将源语音转换为未见过的目标说话人的声音，同时保留其语言内容。尽管近期的系统在转换质量上有所提升，但由于高保真的说话人音色迁移与低延迟的流式推理难以同时实现，为交互式场景构建零样本语音转换系统仍然具有挑战性。在本工作中，我们提出了X-VC，这是一个在预训练神经编解码器的潜在空间中执行一步转换的零样本流式语音转换系统。X-VC采用双条件声学转换器，联合建模源语音的编解码器潜在表示和从目标参考语音中提取的帧级声学条件，同时通过自适应归一化注入话语级的目标说话人信息。为了减少训练与推理之间的不匹配，我们使用生成的配对数据以及一种角色分配策略来训练模型（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: X-VC提出了一种在预训练神经编解码器潜在空间中执行一步转换的零样本流式语音转换系统，通过双条件声学转换器与自适应归一化同时实现了高保真说话人音色迁移和低延迟流式推理。
en_tdlr: X-VC is a zero-shot streaming voice conversion system that performs one-step conversion in the latent space of a pretrained neural codec, simultaneously achieving high-fidelity speaker transfer and low-latency streaming inference through a dual-conditioning acoustic converter with adaptive normalization.
